content.title: 'Survivor 50' Star Stephenie LaGrossa Kendrick Faces Backlash After Anti-Semitic Remarks Towards Fellow Alum Go Viral
content.text: Stephenie LaGrossa Kendrick (L); Eliza Orlins (R). Credit : irginia Sherwood/Peacock via Getty; David X Prutting/BFA/Shutterstock NEED TO KNOW Survivor 50 contestant Stephenie LaGrossa Kendrick faced criticism after anti-Semitic remarks she made on social media went viralWhen making the comments, Kendrick was speaking of fellow Survivor alum Eliza OrlinsKendrick has since apologized for the remarks — which she said were "abrupt, poorly worded, and offensive" — in a newly released statement One Survivor 50 contestant is facing backlash for making anti-Semitic remarks on social media about a fellow Survivor alum. Stephenie LaGrossa Kendrick, a newly minted four-time castaway who first competed on Survivor: Palau (season 10) and most recently wrapped filming for the show's milestone 50th season, made waves online after lashing out at fellow alum Eliza Orlins. Kendrick, seemingly responding to Orlins' recent "exposé" about her that she shared on her Substack, titled "The Stephenie LaGrossa Kendrick Files: MAGA, Misinformation, and Deleted Receipts," addressed Orlins directly in an Instagram video captured by the Daily Mail. Stephenie LaGrossa on 'Survivor: Palau'. Monty Brinton/CBS Photo Archive via Getty "Eliza tried to bury me about Donald Trump. Don't come at me with your political status when you're f------ Jewish and your parents are 1% of the population of wealth," Kendrick said. "We were poor as f---. I worked my ass off to get where I am right now." "Don't you dare try to say I'm some right-wing bigot," she also said. "If you think you're gonna try to f------ ruin me for one second, you're sadly mistaken. Good luck, bitch." PEOPLE has reached out to CBS for comment. Orlins said in a statement to the Daily Mail that she wasn't surprised by Kendrick's remarks. "I'm not surprised by Stephenie's defamatory or bigoted remarks because I've known her for nearly 20 years," the two-time Survivor competitor said. "I didn't know she was anti-Semitic — but again, given her history and the fascistic president she supports, it's not surprising." Lisa Orlins on 'Survivor: Micronesia'. Monty Brinton/CBS via Getty Orlins said she hopes CBS takes note of Kendrick's comments "because I doubt this is the kind of person they want representing their network on the national stage." The New York City public defender is known among the fandom for releasing "exposés" about Survivor contestants because, as she described in the post about Kendrick, she believes "everyone deserves to know who they're rooting for — and what they actually stand for." Related Stories Kendrick told the Daily Mail in a statement she made the video while she was "drinking wine." "During a conversation in which I was calling out someone for what I perceived as a lack of support for the Jewish community, I misspoke in a way that was abrupt, poorly worded, and offensive," the Traitors alum, who is married to former MLB star Kyle Kendrick, said. "What I meant to express was frustration that someone who is Jewish was not standing up for their own community in a moment that called for unity and support," she continued. "However, the way I said it was wrong, and I take full responsibility for how it came across." Stephenie LaGrossa Kendrick (L) and Eliza Orlins (R). irginia Sherwood/Peacock via Getty; David X Prutting/BFA/Shutterstock Kendrick added that she wanted to be "absolutely clear" that she stands "fully and unequivocally in support of the Jewish people" and condemns "all forms of antisemitism, discrimination, and hate." "My comment was not meant to target the Jewish community in any way, and I deeply regret that it may have come across that way," she said. "To those I hurt and offended: I hear you and I am truly sorry. I am committed to learning from this and continuing to be a vocal ally for all marginalized communities, including the Jewish community." Despite their online drama, Kendrick and Orlins never competed on the same season of Survivor. In addition to Survivor: Palau and the forthcoming 50th season, which has wrapped filming, Kendrick also competed on Survivor: Guatemala (season 11) and Survivor: Heroes vs. Villains (season 20). Orlins, meanwhile, competed on Survivor: Vanuatu (season 9) and Survivor: Micronesia (season 16), a.k.a. Survivor: Fans vs. Favorites.
